title: A looping turn comes home and spins evenly without extra keys
goal: Making an icon swing takes a third key that nobody would guess, or it snaps back with a jump every lap, and a spin slows to a stop each lap until its curve is changed. Someone who sets a turn on a repeating picture should get a loop that runs smoothly.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-07: the walk cut off after the key at 1.5s (keys 0, 15 at 0.5s, -15 at 1.5s), written with writeSVG, gives keyTimes="0;0.25;0.75;1" values="0 12 12;15.185 12 12;-15 12 12;-15 12 12": it holds at -15 and restarts at 0, a 15 degree jump every lap. The full walk has to go to 0:02.00 and type 0. Spin: keys 0 and 360 write keySplines="0.4 0 0.2 1" until Curve is set to Linear by hand (the frame walk does that step). Chose to leave the behaviour for this task to design, since it changes what a key means: pictures in queue/audits/2026-11-07-icon-workflow-keys-sc.png.
acceptance: Two turns set on a repeating picture play with no jump where the lap starts over, on the canvas and in the exported SVG
A whole turn on a repeating picture goes round at a steady pace with no stop at the lap
Whatever the app does for you is visible on the strip as keys or a curve you can change, and undoes in one step
A walk at Next defaults proves both with no typed end key
A reel of a swing and a spin each playing three laps on the canvas, and the exported SVG playing in a browser, is in the audit; the frame either side of the lap reads the same angle within 1 degree

log.note: also: a click at the end of the ruler lands on 0:01.99, not 0:02.00, so the last key reads a hundredth short of the lap (queue/audits/2026-11-07-icon-workflow-keys-sc.png)

triage 2026-11-08 spot check: did not rerun the cut-off walk. Both icon workflow walks still carry the workarounds the notes describe (the-whole-icon-workflow-walk types the end key 0, the frame walk picks Linear with the note 'a spin slows to a stop every lap'), and SVGMotionExport still writes spline curves by default. Kept at p1: it is a behaviour the walks have to route around, with the written SVG output in the notes.
triage 2026-11-08: added a reel and a measured lap seam (within 1 degree) to the checklist, since its value is how the motion looks
